scope: This guide is for a complete electric hobby RC car with a working, correctly paired radio. It explains an initial steering check, not radio binding, ESC calibration, charging, advanced geometry or servo replacement. The vehicle, transmitter and receiver manuals take priority, especially for gyro-equipped drift cars. We use documented examples from ARRMA, Kyosho and Traxxas without treating their menu sequences as interchangeable.
notes: Control definitions are based on Spektrum and manufacturer instructions, not assumed identical menu sequences.
Gyro-off is not given as a universal centering instruction.
MZW711 optional on 32652ID; current exact manufacturer guidance overrides older generations.
No servo disassembly, ESC recalibration or battery charging procedure is improvised.
Manufacturer photograph reused with existing ledger provenance; four-control explanatory diagram is original HTML/CSS.
No direct buying links; relevant complete-car reviews use their previously verified affiliate identities.
